title: paired·sealed 평가·분석·budget

schema_change.rationale: paired evaluation operates on in-memory sealed manifests and trial ledgers; durable persistence reuses the WP02 ledger when wired

verification.ruff: 0 findings in WP20-owned paths under cyrano/configs/quality/ruff.toml
verification.formatter: ruff format --check clean on WP20-owned paths
verification.dev_check: dev.py check exit 0 after docs regeneration
verification.quality_gate: 0 findings in WP20-owned paths; pre-existing baseline debt in other files unchanged

architecture.paired: seal_experiment freezes baseline/candidate/suite/runtime/plan/policy/model/route digests, budget, margin, and the train/holdout family split into an immutable EvaluationManifest; family overlap is DATA_LEAKAGE, post-cutoff memory refs are DATA_LEAKAGE, missing preregistration is MISSING_PREREGISTRATION, protected-path changes are PROTECTED_FIELD; TrialLedger is append-only (duplicate pair+arm refused) and failed/aborted specimens never shrink the denominator; build_memory_arms marks bundled policy+memory changes non-attributable pending ablation
architecture.statistics: analyze_families computes per-family paired deltas with Wilson intervals; safety failures yield invalid, insufficient pairs or interval-margin overlap yield inconclusive, never a rounded success; cost_report keeps unknown costs unknown and reports coverage; estimate_utility requires an applied-with-success record for causal reward, exposure alone is correlated
architecture.budget: authorize_experiment refuses without a permit, on expiry, on zero budget, or on families outside the permit scope; begin_spend debits atomically and never lets the account go negative
architecture.gates: judge_candidate routes only to eligibility; safety regression is rejected (HARD_GATE_FAILURE), zero actual pairs invalid, incomplete denominators inconclusive; admit_bundle refuses stale digests, reduced suites, zero collected tests, untrusted producers, tampered bodies, missing raw artifacts, and fixture/self-report evidence; ReleaseLane promotes only a child of the live release (REBASE_REQUIRED for rivals), rollback moves the live pointer while history persists; verify_next_run fails unpinned pre-promotion runs and post-promotion runs not on the live release
architecture.assessment: read_sealed_output denies author/candidate/agent principals the detailed sealed record (aggregate_only); reconstruction_report declares full_reconstruction=false for redacted prompts; tamper_evidence_scope declares intra_bundle_only without a trusted head; bind_baseline_failures blocks claims on cases the baseline already failed; dedupe_dataset counts shared case ids as one obligation

review_findings_resolved: build_memory_arms ignored set-typed changes -> bundled policy+memory not detected
seal_experiment only rejected policies/trust/ -> other protected prefixes slipped through
set-typed families/holdout silently emptied and bypassed the leak check
set-typed spec families bypassed the permit scope check in authorize_experiment
TrialLedger.record silently overwrote a duplicate pair+arm specimen
verify_next_run defaulted missing pins to the used release (accept-anything hole)
not_established: signed_release_provenance (releases are digest-bound objects, not signed artifacts)
